questions.question: Identify which South Pole is intended in the claim about determining geographical coordinates: the geographical or magnetic pole. Verify the precise observational results and the scope of the priority claims.

localizations.source: Identify which South Pole is intended in the claim about determining geographical coordinates: the geographical or magnetic pole. Verify the precise observational results and the scope of the priority claims.
localizations.ru: Уточнить, какой Южный полюс имеется в виду в утверждении об определении географических координат: географический или магнитный. Сверить точные результаты наблюдений и рамки заявленных приоритетов.

questions.resolution: The wording now follows Kazan Federal University’s account: Simonov determined ship and island positions from astronomical observations and calculated the position of the South Magnetic Pole from magnetic data.

questions.question: Verify Bartels’s assessment of Simonov’s place in the Kazan school, the degree and appointment chronology, and the scientific-society memberships.

questions.question: Clarify Simonov’s birthplace. The [Kazan University museum](https://kpfu.ru/imoiv/etnograficheskij-muzej/personalii/simonov-ivan-mihajlovich) gives Astrakhan, while [O. Panteleeva’s study](https://www.echovek.ru/ru/article/o-panteleeva-rektor-kazanskogo-universiteta-pokoritel-yuzhnogo-polyusa-i-m-simonov-stranicy) gives Gorokhovets. Cite a document that resolves the discrepancy or acknowledge both accounts in both editions.
